title: Vivimized
description: A pack that optimized the game with updated optimized mods.
body: A quick modpack for 1.21.9, featuring e4mc, Sodium, WorldEdit, Iris, and Litematica. Includes Complementary Unbound. I try to make these modpacks as soon as I can with the latest version, so players on low end computers, or trying to get the most FPS they can, can play without issue.
